title: Table with result squares
summary: Keeps the table but adds a "Tabule" column with eight mini squares showing which answers you found (lighter blue when you used a letter clue), a small "8 z 8" or "celá tabule" line under the score, and a blue "Hrát" button on days you have not played. On phones the squares sit under the question.
tradeoffs: Smallest change and keeps the scannable table, but it is still a table; squares come from the browser's saved games, so days played on another device show only the score.
